record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: For a semisimple Lie group G acting on a real normed vector space V, a point p∈V with finite stabilizer, R_T={g∈G: ||gp||<T}, a lattice Γ in G, and μ_T the projection to G/Γ of normalized Haar measure on R_T, what is the limiting distribution of μ_T as T→∞?

evidence.quote: Let Γ be a lattice in G, and let µT denote the image of the normalized Haar measure on RT projected to G/Γ. QUESTION 20 (N. Shah) . What is the limiting distribution of the measure µT as T → ∞ ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected semisimple real Lie group equipped with a Haar measure, and let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real vector space endowed with a norm $\|\cdot\|$. Suppose $G$ acts continuously and linearly on $V$, and let $p \in V$ be a point whose stabilizer $\{g \in G : gp = p\}$ is finite. For each $T > 0$, define the "representation ball"
$$R_T = \{ g \in G : \|gp\| < T \},$$
which has finite Haar measure (assume this), and let $\lambda_T$ be the normalized restriction of Haar measure to $R_T$ (a probability measure on $G$).

Let $\Gamma \subset G$ be a lattice, and let $\pi : G \to G/\Gamma$ be the natural projection. Define $\mu_T = \pi_* \lambda_T$, the pushforward probability measure on $G/\Gamma$.

Determine the weak-$*$ limit of $\mu_T$ on $G/\Gamma$ as $T \to \infty$: does the limit exist, and if so, identify it explicitly (e.g., as the $G$-invariant probability measure on $G/\Gamma$, or as a measure supported on a proper homogeneous subspace, in terms of $G$, $V$, the action, and $p$).
artifact.status_search_result: Equidistribution of such representation-ball averages has been established in many cases via work of Eskin–McMullen, Eskin–Mozes–Shah, Gorodnik–Oh, Gorodnik–Weiss and others, particularly when the orbit $Gp$ is affine symmetric or the stabilizer is reductive, yielding convergence to the Haar probability measure on $G/\Gamma$. A complete answer in the full generality stated (arbitrary linear representation with finite stabilizer) does not appear to be fully settled, so the problem is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.snippet: Shah's work on limit distributions of expanding translates of orbits on G/Γ.
status_evidence.claim: Related equidistribution results have been established for expanding translates of orbits.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous asymptotic limits of Haar measures of semisimple linear groups and their lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Gorodnik–Weiss type results on homogeneous asymptotic limits of Haar measures projected to G/Γ.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results give the limiting distribution under additional hypotheses on the orbit/stabilizer.
